notes.title: First patch is here!
notes.content:
Dear players,

You can now update your game with the first TDF 2024 patch.

Visual

 Added new unlicensed headsets.
 Pro Team/Pro Leader mode: activation of licensed equipment.
 Criterium Mode: correction of wrong skin color and body shape.
Gameplay

 AI: Fixed sprint trains being too slow at the end of a stage.
 AI: Fixed cases where the race leader works at the head of the group to catch up with riders who are not very dangerous for him while his main rivals are in the same group.
 AI: Fixed cases where a leader is working at the head of the group while he still has teammates.
 AI: Fixed cases where a leader puts his best climbers to work from the start of a mountain stage while he still has riders to keep the pace.
 AI: Fixed the role “Aim for the mountain ranking” which no longer worked.
 AI: Fixed dropped rider when using Fast Forward from the start.
 AI: Fixed cases of escaped riders no longer wanting to collaborate without a valid reason.
 AI: Fixed the composition of morning breakaways on flat races to no longer only have breakaway climbers.
 AI: Fixed cases of peloton being too passive on classics.
 Pro Team/Pro Leader mode: fixed cases where races are not unlocked despite the required conditions being met.
 Fixed loss of tracking due to triggering save.
 Updated rider notes and squads.
Multi 

 Criterium mode: adjustment on the change of rider to avoid taking control in the middle of a turn.
 Race of the Moment: correction of problem sending results.
 Split Screen Mode: Fixed cases where the player could get dropped when using Fast Forward.
 Split Screen Mode (Versus): Fixed the wrong rider being controlled at the start for player 2.
UI

 Fixed incorrect icons in the Fast Forward menu.
 Fixed the ranking of intermediate sprints which do not display 15th position.
 Fixed flickering issues on the main menu.
 Fixed an issue with sorting riders in the Editor Registrations menu.
 Activation of the display of energy gauges for teammates on the rider cartridge.
 Criterium mode: change of the icon indicating that changing riders is not possible.
 Split Screen Mode: Restored the display of player 2's name during the race.
 Split Screen Mode: Fixed incorrectly displayed text on the results page.
 Split Screen Mode: correction of incorrect display at the start of time trials.
 Split Screen Mode: Fixed incorrect display when a player finishes the race.
Audio

 Setting the triggering of comments to Fast Forward to have fewer delayed comments.
 Adjusted the inappropriate triggering of certain comments during the race.
 Re-enabled split-screen comments.
 Fixed case where the Sports Director starts the briefing at the same time as the stage intro video.

notes.title: Devblog - Features.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In our final devblog, we want to talk about various adjustments we've made to the game.

AI 
Let's start with artificial intelligence. We have mainly focused on gravel roads. As you probably know, stage 9 of the Tour de France is on gravel roads. We've made various modifications so that this type of stage is managed in a specific way. Our goal is to make it unpredictable with multiple scenarios possible: baroudeur victory, small group sprint victory, solo victory, etc. We've put in a lot of effort to create different scenarios in this stage, which promises to be a highlight of the Tour.

We've also focused on the way in which the peloton organizes the pursuit of a breakaway. We've improved the selection of team members that need to ride at any given moment and ensured that climbers, for example, don't take over at the head of the peloton on flat terrain while good rouleurs are still there to chase. Responsibility for the chase has also been tweaked a little. 

Previously, the Yellow Jersey's team would keep a relatively sustained pace, which could thwart a breakaway. 
Now, although the Yellow Jersey's team takes part in the chase, it's mainly the teams interested in winning the stage that close the gap to catch the early breakaway. 

Be careful, however, because on hilly stages, the teams aiming for victory can now try to send their stage leader into the breakaway, which frees them from the pressure of the race. The chase on mountain stages has also been adjusted with the peloton no longer necessarily wanting to catch the breakaway as quickly as before. Modifications have also been made to breakaways so that more teams (including the leaders' teams) try to put riders up front, which increases the size of early breakaways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/0db1a53bf7f08dcb909c0e4694c57a931b16280f.png
We have also made some modifications to time-trials following feedback from players last year so that times set by opponents are more consistent. However, the biggest problem was with team time-trials and the group of riders. We have adjusted it so that the weakest riders can no longer be left behind in the early kilometres and that tired riders cause fewer breaks so that teams are more consistent and efficient, which means these special events are more fun to play.

NEW OPTIONS
New options have also been added to the game. The subtitles have been completely overhauled to be more customizable and to improve the game's accessibility. As requested by certain members of our Discord community, the distinctive Paris-Nice and Dauphiné jerseys can now be selected in My Tour to customize your races. You can also choose to use the rules for these two races instead of the Tour de France rules for a different experience. For example, Paris-Nice rules allow points to be doubled during the final ascent of each stage. A great reason to revisit your strategy for claiming the polka-dot jersey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/81bd5be213529ea981690d891d95e3fe77f02a85.png

That's it for our final devblog. We have a few other little surprises planned, but we'll let you discover them for yourselves in a few days on your favourite platform.

Thanks for reading us!

notes.title: Devblog - Introducing Criterium Mode.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In our first devblog for Tour de France 2024, we want to talk about the biggest update in this edition: Criterium mode. This mode features online races between a maximum of 6 players. The aim is simple: the first to finish wins the race! But it's important to remember that conditions can completely change between races. 

[previewyoutube=cpbeHpBf4Ms;full][/previewyoutube]
Random chance

Different settings will be chosen randomly at the start to create varied conditions that players will need to adapt to each time. After the stage is chosen (selected randomly from all stages available except for time trials), the game selects a distance (between 30km and 50km) and the type of team that players will need to control. The game will also change a game setting such as whether a team-mate is in the race or the ability to take a feed. This randomness creates a variety of situations that will need to be understood and evaluated if you want to gain the upper hand and claim victory at the finish line.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/9c8308ee3e1057559c47b95384930cd5ffe59b9e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/d6f131ed919e892260d831df97d2ed0018a64ced.jpg
Teams

The teams used in Criterium mode are not the same as Pro Team or World Tour teams from the game's single-player mode. In Criterium mode, each player controls a team of two riders: a leader and a team-mate. And each player has four types of teams: a "flat" team, a "hill" team, a "mountain" team and one called "versatile". As mentioned in the previous paragraph, the game selects a type of team that all players must use, and it's entirely possible that players will need to compete on a mountain stage with a "flat" team! Some scenarios would be unlikely in real life, but that's deliberate. We want to break away from traditional conventions, and we can't wait to see how you cope on the cobbled streets of Paris-Roubaix with the "mountain" team 😉.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/103911029efa6eec8fec10c7590b00ba5cc16083.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/1708bdb8fb2caf2c7e30965399d4f61f2165e6e9.png
The composition of each type of team is the same. For example, the leader of the "flat" team must be a sprinter while the team-mate must be a versatile rider. You can choose to put any sprinter as the leader from the ones you have available (certain riders need to be unlocked, more on this later). I know what you're going to ask, and the answer is no! If you use Philipsen as the leader of your "flat" team, you won't gain an advantage. All the "flat" team leaders have the same ratings. Whether you use Philipsen, Merlier, Ewan or Viviani, they all have the same ratings. We want all players to be on an equal footing and that their strategies and choices during the race are what make the difference.

Rewards

Not all riders will be available when you start the game. The more prestigious riders can be unlocked with Criterium Points. You can unlock them simply by playing. You gain points for every kilometre raced, and then these points are multiplied at the end of the race based on your ranking. There are no other ways to obtain points, and only Criterium Points can unlock rewards – you can't purchase anything!

Rewards are refreshed every week and are specific to each player. This means that you might unlock Tadej Pogacar as a reward and the Visma | Lease a Bike jersey (to customize your teams' appearance), while another player might unlock Jonas Vingegaard and the UAE Team Emirates team jersey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/9a11748d332bbe926ba1603c08119de734b9202f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904586/4e0b813b09b5244a077f55622a6acbaaece5474c.png
Criterium mode joins Race of the Moment and Downhill of the Moment in the dedicated online section of Tour de France. We hope lots of you will enjoy this new mode and that the variety of situations will provide an all-new experience for you.
